groups.defect: wire.go still registers ProvideAnonDBStore and the AnonStore bind, but the provider now needs an int64 that nothing supplies, so wire generation and the server build fail.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same signature change and the same stale wire.go registration, and they propose the same fix.

groups.defect: The device limit is a non-atomic count-then-insert, so concurrent requests from new devices can push the count past the limit.
groups.rationale: Both report the same check-then-act race in CreateOrUpdateDevice at the same lines.

groups.defect: The local cache key is written before CreateOrUpdateDevice and kept when it fails, so the limit blocks only a device's first request in each cache window.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same stale-cache bypass of the limit and propose the same fix.

groups.defect: On MySQL, rowsAffected==0 also happens for a matched row whose values did not change, so an existing device is wrongly rejected with ErrDeviceLimitReached.
groups.rationale: Both report the same MySQL RowsAffected problem in updateDevice at the same lines.
